faq.a: Yes, it is completely safe. The INDIBA radiofrequency system is non-invasive, approved for medical-aesthetic use, requires no anaesthesia or recovery and has been used for decades in sports medicine, physiotherapy and advanced aesthetic clinics.

faq.q: Does the INDIBA Radiofrequency treatment hurt?
faq.a: No, it is painless. The sensation is one of pleasant deep warmth in the treated area. Most patients describe the session as relaxing. No anaesthesia required.

faq.q: When will I see results from INDIBA radiofrequency?
faq.a: Results are visible from the first session and continue to improve with each treatment. For optimal, long-lasting results we recommend completing the full 10-session pack.

faq.q: What makes INDIBA Radiofrequency different from other radiofrequencies?
faq.a: INDIBA radiofrequency works at 448 kHz, a patented frequency that safely penetrates the deep (hypodermic) layers. Other radiofrequencies operate at more superficial frequencies or are more aggressive and painful. INDIBA Radiofrequency is the clinical reference for deep firming without surgery.

faq.q: Can INDIBA Radiofrequency be combined with other treatments?
faq.a: Yes. INDIBA Radiofrequency enhances and combines seamlessly with Ultherapy/HIFU, wood therapy, mesotherapy and peels. During the free assessment we design the optimal combined plan for you.

faq.q: How many INDIBA Radiofrequency sessions do I need?
faq.a: We recommend a 10-session pack (1-2 per week) for optimal results. The exact number depends on the treatment area and goal. During your first (free) assessment we evaluate your case and design the right plan.

faq.q: How much does the INDIBA Radiofrequency Pack cost?
faq.a: The 10-session 45-min pack costs €500 — €50 per session, saving you €375 versus buying everything separately. There is also a 10-session 30-min pack for €350 and a 5-session 30-min pack for €250. Single sessions range from €45 to €85 depending on duration and area. Free initial assessment, no strings attached.

items.h3: You have tried creams, massages and devices elsewhere.

why.h2: Six reasons this technology changes the game.
why.p: It is not magic and it is not marketing. It is physics applied to your physiology.

items.p_html: INDIBA radiofrequency works at 448 kHz, a patented frequency that reaches the hypodermic layer. Where a surgeon would cut to perform a lifting, we stimulate without opening the skin.
We do not inject substances. INDIBA Radiofrequency reactivates the natural production of collagen and elastin your body already knows how to make — it has just slowed down with age.
You do not have to wait three months to see "something". You leave the first session with brighter, firmer skin. The full effect builds over the 10-Session Pack.
The session is relaxing — pleasant deep warmth. You leave and carry on with your day: lunch, work, gym. No marks, no creams, no rest.

items.h3: Compatible with Ultherapy HIFU, mesotherapy and peels
items.p_html: INDIBA Radiofrequency enhances and combines with everything you are already doing. During the assessment we design the combined plan that multiplies results.

items.h3: Treated by the person who owns the result
items.p_html: No conveyor belt of trainees here. You are seen by someone who has worked with this technology for decades and knows exactly where to insist — and where not — for your case.

mod.h2: INDIBA Radiofrequency Facial and INDIBA Radiofrequency Body.

process.h2: Four steps. No surprises, no small print.
process.p: From your first message to seeing the first improvement is less than two weeks.

steps.p: Call or WhatsApp to find a slot. 30 minutes in clinic, no cost and no commitment. We reply in under 24 hours.
We review the area, your history and your expectations. If INDIBA Radiofrequency is not the right fit for your case, we tell you straight and point you toward what is.
We design the protocol, frequency (1-2 sessions per week) and treatment areas. You start when you decide — no pressure.
Direct WhatsApp between sessions for questions or adjustments. After the pack, a 60-day review to plan maintenance. We do not vanish once we have been paid.
